verdict.rationale: Render's own marketing claims ephemeral previews of the entire application architecture for every change, which maps to per-PR preview environments. The evidence is a single homepage line that never mentions pull requests, an automatically generated URL, or how previews are triggered and torn down. Missing for 10: explicit pull-request triggering, documented automatic preview URL generation, configuration and lifecycle docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get an automatic preview URL for every pull request

citations.quote: Iterate quickly with ephemeral previews of your entire application architecture for every change.
